description: Hold any strategy's daily returns against named market crises (2000-02 dot-com bust, 2008-09 bank crisis, 2011 US downgrade and euro debt scare, 2013 taper tantrum in bonds and others): its return, drawdown and worst day in each one its dates fully cover, and the crises it was not there for, listed as untested and never as passed.

drawdown_limit.description: A drawdown beyond this inside one crisis counts as a rupture. Default 0.5.

returns_file.description: CSV: a date column (YYYY-MM-DD) and one column of daily returns per strategy, at most 50.

name: crisis_replay
title: Replay strategies through named crises
